direction: New composition matching the original dreamy/storybook, mischievous journey and heartwarming score structure. No MacLeod recording or original master is reused.

sections.intent: Quiet desk and opening: dreamy harp, soft piano, warm strings
Papervale: light flute melody over lilting pizzicato
Dusk curiosity: descending piano, luminous warm sustained strings
Forest journey and comic obstruction: clarinet and pizzicato
Kind smoothing and Fold: harp rise, celesta and a new friendship motif
Sea: swinging flute and pizzicato in compound lilt
Night: suspended glockenspiel stars over quiet strings
Last page and hesitation: sparse piano, low held cello
Catch and flight: expanding string harmony and rising flute
Lamp recognition, greeting and title: warm piano reprise and settled harp
